name: CWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The first champion on its title-history page is Huckster, from 26 October 1997; 35 reigns are recorded, the last held by Paul Blair and still running when the record ends.
notes: Its title-history page runs in five blocks of dated reigns, 1997 to 2001 and again from 2005, with 'CWF Closed' standing where the federation shut down and all titles were vacated.
